sourceLeakAudit.note: This budget-layer prototype moves plaintext sensitive values to the server-side reveal endpoint. It protects source text but introduces an endpoint that must be authenticated/rate-limited in production.

interpretation.session: Session-only budgets stop a single cookie identity but are bypassed by rotating sessions on the same IP.
interpretation.ip: IP-only budgets stop session rotation but are bypassed by rotating IPs and can affect shared NAT/proxy users.
interpretation.sessionIp: A single combined session|IP key is bypassed by rotating either component, so it is weaker than independent budgets for adversarial rotation.
interpretation.dual: Independent session and IP budgets must both allow the reveal. This stops session-only and IP-only rotation, but not simultaneous rotation of both identities.
